item.title: New barbecue joint opens on Magnolia Avenue in Near Southside
item.description: A family-run smokehouse opened its doors on Magnolia Avenue this week, serving brisket, sausage and jalapeño cheddar sides out of a renovated 1920s storefront. Lines wrapped around the block on opening day.

item.title: Crash shuts down northbound I-35W near downtown Fort Worth during morning rush
item.description: All northbound lanes of Interstate 35W were closed near the downtown Fort Worth mixmaster after a multi-vehicle crash involving an 18-wheeler. Police say minor injuries were reported and drivers should use alternate routes.

item.title: Dickies Arena announces 2027 concert lineup with six new shows
item.description: Dickies Arena added six concerts to its 2027 calendar, including two country headliners and a comedy tour. Tickets go on sale Friday at 10 a.m.

item.title: Fort Worth City Council approves budget after marathon meeting
item.description: The council vote came after six hours of public comment on the city budget and property tax rate.

item.title: Kimbell Art Museum unveils new impressionist exhibit in the Cultural District
item.description: The Kimbell Art Museum opens a touring exhibition of 60 impressionist works this weekend. Admission to the permanent collection remains free.

item.title: Obituary: longtime Fort Worth rancher dies at 94
item.description: Family and friends will gather Saturday to remember a fixture of the Stockyards cattle community.

item.title: TCU basketball opens season at Schollmaier Arena with a blowout win
item.description: The Horned Frogs rolled past their season-opening opponent in front of a sold-out Schollmaier Arena crowd on Tuesday night.
